sections.description:
REGULATION I OF 2001
PROVINCIALLY
ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS (APPLICATION OF ELECTIONS LAW) REGULATION, 2001
REGULATION I OF 2001
A Regulation to
apply certain laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the
North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th August, 2001]
No. Legis: 1(9)/70/4331-36,
dated 27-8-2001.--The following Regulation made by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province with the approval of the President is hereby
published for general information.
Whereas it is expedient to apply
certain laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West
Frontier Province;
And whereas clause (4) of Article
247 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan provides that the
Governor of a Province, with the prior approval of the President, may, with
respect to any matter within the legislative competence of the Provincial
Assembly, make regulations for the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas or
any part thereof;
Now therefore, in pursuance of
the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999, and the Powers and Functions
of the Governor's Order, 1999 (C.E. Order No.5 of 1999), read with clause (4)
of Article 247 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, and in
exercise of all powers enabling him in that behalf, the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province, with the prior approval of the President, is
pleased to make the following Regulation:
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Regulation may be called the Provincially Administered
Tribal Areas (Application of Elections Law) Regulation, 2001.
(2) It shall apply to whole of
the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 14th day of December,
2000.
2. Application of laws.--The
North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
(N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. VI of 2000), the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. VII of 2000),
and the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections (Second
Amendment) Ordinance, 2000 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. IX of 2000), and, so far as may be,
all rules, orders, notifications made or issued thereunder on or after the 14th
December, 2000, shall apply to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas.
3. Certain laws to cease to
operate.--(1) If, immediately before the commencement of this regulation,
there was in force in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas or any part
thereof any law, instruments, custom or usage having the force of law
corresponding to the provision of the Ordinances mentioned in section 2, then
such law, instrument, custom or usage shall, upon such commencement, ceases to
have effect in the said areas.
(2) Nothing in subsection (1)
shall effect,--
(a)
the previous operation of such law, instrument custom or usage, or
(b)
any obligation or liability acquired or accrued or any penalty, forfeiture or punishment incurred in respect of any
offence punishable under such law, instrument,
custom or usage; or
(c)
any investigation, legal proceeding or remedy in respect of any such obligation, liability, penalty, forfeiture or
punishment may be imposed, as if subsection
(1) had not come into force.
4. Validation.--Anything
done, proceeding initiated, order passed, power exercised and power conferred
on, or by any Authority under the laws specified in section 2 and rules, orders
and notifications made or issued thereunder on or after the 14th December,
2000, shall be deemed to have been validly done, initiated, passed, issued,
exercised and conferred.
